items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: And Joe Lindsay used to play drum.

ctx.x: Is he uptown or across the river? Where did he come from?

He come from uptown. Uptown. That way. And Joe Lindsay used to play drum. Johnny Lindsay on trombone, Joe Lindsay on drum. And then after Johnny Lindsay, I believe, he went on bass. And after he died, I believe.
I asked Joe if they were related and he said no.
